basic_details.job_title: District and Sessions Judge Kullu Oath Commissioner Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | oath commissioner: Advocate presently practicing at Manali and passed the examination as per Rule 9 of All India Bar Examination Rules, 2010.

selection_process: The selection process involves scrutiny of applications by the Civil Judge-cum-JMFC
followed by forwarding to the Hon'ble High Court of Himachal Pradesh
how_to_apply: Obtain the prescribed proforma Annexure-'A' from the overleaf of the official notification.
Fill out the proforma with the required details including enrollment number and date, standing at the bar, and monthly income details.
Attach a certificate issued by the concerned Bar Association regarding enrollment in that Bar Association.
Attach a certified or attested photo copy of the enrollment certificate or identity card.
Attach a certificate issued by the concerned Bar Association regarding character and antecedents/good moral character.
Attach certified or attested photo copies of the category certificate, if any.
Attach certificate or attested photo copies of passing the examination as per Rule 9 of All India Bar Examination Rules, 2010.
Submit the completed application in person on or before 14 October 2026 through the office of the Civil Judge-cum-JMFC, Manali, District Kullu.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for the Oath Commissioner post?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Office of the District and Sessions Judge, Kullu, H.P.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There is 1 anticipated vacancy for the Oath Commissioner at Manali.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 14 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Oath Commissioner post?
faq.answer: Applicants must be advocates presently practicing at Manali and must have passed the examination as per Rule 9 of All India Bar Examination Rules, 2010.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: The application mode is offline through the office of the Civil Judge-cum-JMFC, Manali, District Kullu.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinized by the Civil Judge-cum-JMFC Manali and forwarded to the Hon'ble High Court of Himachal Pradesh, Shimla for appointment.

faq.question: Q8. What documents must be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach Bar Association enrollment certificates, attested photo copy of enrollment certificate/ID card, character certificate, category certificates if any, and proof of passing the AIBE Rule 9 examination.
